name: ha--room-sensor-staleness-guard
description: LivingR/BedroomB comfort-band automations now cross-check the Xiaomi room temperature sensor against the climate unit's own ac_temp sensor. A room sensor whose numeric value has not genuinely moved (>=0.1C) in the configured window (default 5h) is treated as stale and the climate's own sensor is used instead. If both sensors are healthy but disagree beyond a tunable threshold (default 1.5C), the less comfortable (worst-case) reading wins instead of blindly trusting the room sensor.

changes: setup_room_sensor_staleness_guard.js: creates 7 input_number helpers (per-sensor last_seen_value for livingr_room, bedroomb_room_primary, bedroomb_room_secondary; per-room stale_hours + ac_disagreement_threshold for livingr and bedroomb) and 3 input_datetime *_last_moved helpers, plus a new automation id=1770077000099 '[TEST] AirCon - room sensor fluctuation tracker' (entity: automation.test_aircon_room_sensor_fluctuation_tracker) that updates *_last_seen_value/*_last_moved only when a tracked sensor's numeric state changes by >=0.1C, independent of unavailable-flicker state churn

sync_climate_setup_templates.js: buildSetup() now computes *_stale (now - last_moved > stale_hours) and *_healthy (not stale) per room sensor, then source/effective picks 'conflict_worst_case' (max in summer / min in winter / room value in neutral mode) when a healthy room sensor disagrees with ac_temp by >= the room's disagreement threshold; refactored from a self-executing IIFE into exported buildSetup/replaceSetupTemplates/applyAndRearm (module.exports) gated by require.main so callers can reuse the template patch without forcing automation.turn_on

apply_climate_setup_templates_config_only.js: new thin wrapper that calls replaceSetupTemplates for both automations and reloads config WITHOUT calling automation.turn_on, since the comfort automations are intentionally left disabled while the user runs the AC in manual mode

checks: C1: input_number/input_datetime helper list (WS) contains all 7 input_number + 3 input_datetime staleness-guard helpers with expected defaults (stale_hours=5, ac_disagreement_threshold=1.5, last_seen_value=0.0 pre-fluctuation)
C2: automation.test_aircon_room_sensor_fluctuation_tracker exists (REST config, id=1770077000099) and state=on
C3: /api/template render of buildSetup('livingr') + debug tail returns source/effective/room_stale/room_healthy keys with sane types (no template error)
C4: /api/template render of buildSetup('bedroomb') + debug tail returns source/effective/primary_stale/secondary_stale/primary_healthy/secondary_healthy keys with sane types (no template error)

C5: after apply_climate_setup_templates_config_only.js runs, both automation.test_aircon_livingr_room_sensor_comfort_band and automation.test_aircon_bedroomb_room_sensor_comfort_band remain state=off (config patched but NOT re-armed, since user has manual override active)
